briefing: NASDAQ +1.6% and S&P 500 +1.1% mark a risk-on day, and with 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold we deployed into three momentum-confirmed names (F, BLSH, ONDS) with lower RSI readings to reduce overbought risk. Existing winning positions were left untouched to let stop-loss and profit targets manage them automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that strong recent performance tends to continue in the short term. Traders look for signals like a rising MACD histogram and RSI in a healthy (not overbought) range to confirm the trend has real strength before jumping in.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量投資（Momentum Investing）是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，因為近期表現強勁的股票短期內往往會延續升勢。投資者會留意MACD柱狀圖上升、RSI處於健康（非超買）區間等訊號，以確認升勢具備真正動力，才決定入市。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today, with the NASDAQ up 1.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.1%, reflects continued risk appetite across growth and value sectors alike. Momentum names showing bullish MACD crossovers and RSI readings in the healthy 55-70 range attracted fresh buying interest. No single catalyst headline is available for today, so the move reflects broad-based sentiment rather than one specific event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走強，納斯達克指數上升1.6%，標普500指數上升1.1%，反映成長股及價值股同時受到資金追捧，市場風險胃納持續。MACD出現黃金交叉、RSI處於55至70健康區間的動力股份吸引新買盤。今日並無單一新聞事件可解釋今日升勢，屬於較廣泛的市場情緒帶動。

trades.reasoning: Fresh MACD bullish crossover with RSI 55.4 just entering the bullish zone and price above SMA-20 offers a low-overbought-risk entry on a risk-on day.
Score 95 with RSI 55.2, rising MACD histogram, and price above SMA-20 signals fresh institutional momentum without being overbought.
All four bullish signals confirmed (RSI 56.8, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20) and diversifies away from existing tech/industrial holdings.
